hook: Your road in Madagascar is lined with giants.
title: Your Road in Madagascar Is Lined With Giants
description:
The Avenue of the Baobabs near Morondava in Madagascar is a road lined with enormous baobab trees standing alone in a row. They are survivors of a forest that once covered the area, and they tower over every passing car. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #PlacesThatShouldntExist #Madagascar
